title: Structured Bindings
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas of Structured Bindings.
Identify the language rules and relevant C++ constructs.
Apply the topic in a small program.
Recognize common pitfalls and safety concerns.
Test an example and justify design decisions.

understand.concept: Structured bindings (C++17) unpack eligible arrays, tuples, pairs and aggregates into named variables. auto copies, auto& binds by reference, and const auto& avoids copies while preventing mutation.
understand.whyItMatters: Named bindings make multi-value results more readable than repeated numeric access.
understand.explain: Use descriptive names and choose copy/reference binding intentionally. Structured bindings are a C++17 feature and not universal destructuring.
